simple.meaning: מְלִילָה (mᵉlîylâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a head of grain (as cut off).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְלִילָה (H4425) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְלִילָה (H4425) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְלִילָה (mᵉlîylâh) / H4425 is traced through Deuteronomy 23:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a head of grain (as cut off)
definitions.full: H4425. melilah [ מְלִילָה ] noun feminine ear of wheat , etc. (perhaps as rubbed or scraped , compare Late Hebrew מְלִילוֺת הַמּוֺלֵל ); — only plural absolute מְלִילוֺת Deuteronomy 23:26 (compare Di).
definitions.rootNote: from 4448 number 4449, corrected to 4448b (in the sense of cropping (compare 4135 ));
